_comment: Tuning overrides only. The model list comes from llama-server --cache-list plus installed MTPLX packs (discover_models.sh). Any cached model not listed here still appears in the menu and launches with llama-fit-params-computed ctx/ngl. backend: llamacpp (default) or mtplx (ids ending :MTPLX); mtplx honours ctx_size, reasoning, temp, top_p, top_k. short_name (optional, <=24 chars) is the menu bar label; defaults to name.

Youssofal/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTPLX-Optim.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (MTPLX)
Youssofal/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTPLX-Optim.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B MoE on MTPLX (MLX + native MTP, dynamic 4-bit). ~95 tok/s at 4K, ~76 at 22K context on this M5 Max (2026-09-25 bench). Instruct mode: temp 0.7, top_p 0.80, top_k 20.

Youssofal/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Qu.name: Qwen3.8-27B (MTPLX)
Youssofal/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Qu.description: Qwen3.8-27B dense on MTPLX (8-bit, 99.3% top-1 vs BF16, native MTP). ~51 tok/s at 4K, ~46 at 22K context (2026-09-25 bench). Instruct mode.

bartowski/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF:Q4_K_M.name: Muse-Glimmer-30B Q4_K_M
bartowski/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF:Q4_K_M.description: Coding and analysis. Q4_K_M: 2.8x faster than BF16 (28 tok/s).

bartowski/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF:Q5_K_M.name: Muse-Glimmer-30B Q5_K_M
bartowski/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF:Q5_K_M.description: Higher quality than Q4, 2.2x faster than BF16 (22 tok/s).

unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-GGUF:Q2_K.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, UD-Q2_K_XL ~90 GB, DSpark draft + think-high defaults

vcruz305/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-GGUF:Q2_K.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 552B MoE Q2_K, 1M context, DSpark draft

unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:IQ4_XS.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B MoE IQ4_XS, 262K context, unsloth GGUF. Instruct mode (enable_thinking=false): temp 0.7, top_p 0.80, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5, min_p 0.0

ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-C.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO Coder IQ1_M
ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-C.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next coder variant, 50% of experts pruned (256 of 512 kept), GSQ-RCO IQ1_M, 58.4 GB in two shards plus BF16 mmproj. llama-fit-params on this M5 Max (2026-10-06): full 262K context, all layers on Metal; estimated 35.2 GiB Metal (27.3 weights, 6.9 KV, 1.1 compute) plus 27.1 GiB host for the n-gram table shard. Instruct mode, same sampling as the IQ4_XS entry; the model card's benchmarks were run at xhigh reasoning.
